lines.text: Yet again, everyone gathered the materials Levi requested.
At last, it was I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, who brought the most materials!
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, began to ponder.
All of this is thanks to my brilliant plan.
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, resolved:
I shall not be intoxicated by this glory.
I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, recalled once more:
my limits are boundless, and I shall press onward toward them without cease!
Truly, I, the unparalleled clever Bahamut, am the epitome of genius!
